WITH objRec AS ( SELECT TMP.PRD_REGIST_CODE ,TMP.INDENTIFY_MARK ,TMP.HOLD_DATE
,MAX(ZZ.MDATE) MDATE
FROM ( SELECT PRD_REGIST_CODE, INDENTIFY_MARK, HOLD_DATE, MAX(STATUS) STATUS FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB WHERE STATUS IN (#{statusNew,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{statusModify,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(HOLD_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
#{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY PRD_REGIST_CODE, HOLD_DATE, INDENTIFY_MARK ) TMP
INNER JOIN CHB_PRD_END_SUB ZZ ON TMP.PRD_REGIST_CODE = ZZ.PROD_REGIST_CODE
GROUP BY TMP.PRD_REGIST_CODE ,TMP.INDENTIFY_MARK ,TMP.HOLD_DATE ) SELECT objRec.PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode ,objRec.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark ,objRec.HOLD_DATE holdDate
,CP.ISSUING_STATUS prdIssueSts ,objRec.MDATE prdAclMDate
FROM objRec
LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO CP ON objRec.PRD_REGIST_CODE = CP.REG_CODE WHERE ( CP.ISSUING_STATUS = #{issuingFail,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR ( objRec.MDATE IS NOT NULL AND objRec.MDATE < objRec.HOLD_DATE))

WITH OBJREC AS ( SELECT A.PROD_REGIST_CODE, A.SINGLE_TOTAL, A.LEGAL_TOTAL, A.UNLEGAL_TOTAL, B.VDATE, MAX(A.STATUS) FROM CHB_PRD_RAISETOT_SUB A LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO B ON A.PROD_REGIST_CODE = B.REG_CODE WHERE TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(B.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
#{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND A.STATUS IN (#{statusNew,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{statusModify,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) GROUP BY A.PROD_REGIST_CODE, A.SINGLE_TOTAL, A.LEGAL_TOTAL, A.UNLEGAL_TOTAL, B.VDATE ) SELECT INFO.prdRegistCode, INFO.prdSingleTotal, INFO.prdLegalTotal, INFO.prdUnLegalTotal, INFO.prdVDate, INFO.indentifyMark, INFO.holdDate, INFO.investSingleTotal, INFO.investLegalTotal, INFO.investUnLegalTotal,
((case when INFO.prdSingleTotal != INFO.investSingleTotal then 1 else 0 end) + (case when INFO.prdLegalTotal != INFO.investLegalTotal then 1 else 0 end) + (case when INFO.prdUnLegalTotal != INFO.investUnLegalTotal then 1 else 0 end)) errRecTotal FROM ( SELECT tmp.PROD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, tmp.SINGLE_TOTAL prdSingleTotal, tmp.LEGAL_TOTAL prdLegalTotal, tmp.UNLEGAL_TOTAL prdUnLegalTotal, tmp.VDATE prdVDate, tmp.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, tmp.HOLD_DATE holdDate, SUM(case when instr('${prdSingleTotalStr}', C.HOLDER_TYPE) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) investSingleTotal, SUM(case when instr('${prdLegalTotalStr}', C.HOLDER_TYPE) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) investLegalTotal, SUM(case when instr('${prdUnLegalTotalStr}', C.HOLDER_TYPE) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) investUnLegalTotal, MAX(c.update_time) FROM ( SELECT A.PROD_REGIST_CODE, A.SINGLE_TOTAL, A.LEGAL_TOTAL, A.UNLEGAL_TOTAL, A.VDATE, B.INDENTIFY_MARK, B.HOLD_DATE, MAX(B.STATUS) FROM OBJREC A INNER JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB B ON A.PROD_REGIST_CODE = B.PRD_REGIST_CODE AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(b.HOLD_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY A.PROD_REGIST_CODE, A.SINGLE_TOTAL, A.LEGAL_TOTAL, A.UNLEGAL_TOTAL, A.VDATE, B.INDENTIFY_MARK, B.HOLD_DATE ) tmp INNER JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB C ON tmp.INDENTIFY_MARK = c.INDENTIFY_MARK GROUP BY tmp.PROD_REGIST_CODE, tmp.SINGLE_TOTAL, tmp.LEGAL_TOTAL, tmp.UNLEGAL_TOTAL, tmp.VDATE, tmp.INDENTIFY_MARK, tmp.HOLD_DATE ) INFO WHERE INFO.prdSingleTotal != INFO.investSingleTotal or INFO.prdLegalTotal != INFO.investLegalTotal or INFO.prdUnLegalTotal != INFO.investUnLegalTotal
